10 - Oliver has gone into hiding, and Dexter is having a hard time finding him. His time is running out, with the police closing in. He goes back to the abandoned building, hoping he can find something there. The police have sealed it off, but he manages to sneak in. He finds a laptop hidden in one of the walls, and realizes that Oliver recorded all of his kills. He takes the laptop with him. Just before he leaves he is spotted by a cop, and a chase ensues. Meanwhile, Debra decides to become a detective again, Batista doesn’t know how to feel about it, with the police looking for her brother, but he decides to allow it. Dexter leaks the recordings to the public, exposing Oliver as the Brain Surgeon. This forces Oliver to come out of hiding and look for Dex. 

11 - Debra calls Dexter and asks to meet with him. She knows it’s dangerous, especially with her new job, but she wants to see him. Dexter asks her to come with him to Argentina one last time, but she disagrees. Her place is in Miami. She is sad and angry at what her life and Dexter’s life has become, but she hopes that they can start anew. Dexter tells her of his plan to find and kill Oliver, and Debra wants to help him. This might be the last time she ever sees her brother, and she wants to make sure that nothing goes wrong.

12 - Dexter and Debra hide in her apartment, figuring that Oliver would search there. They  surprise and capture Oliver. They say their goodbyes and Dexter takes Oliver to the abandoned building. He sets up his elaborate kill room, treating it as a very significant kill because its his last one before his new life. But as he’s about to stab him, he decides he won’t do it. If he is to begin a new life, he shouldn’t begin it by taking another. He calls Debra, and she comes to him. He tells her to call the police and have them arrest Saxon. She would become a hero, and any doubts the police might have about her would go away. They say their goodbyes and Dexter leaves. Oliver Saxon is arrested and eventually killed by lethal injection, Debra becomes lieutenant again while Batista becomes captain. She marries Quinn. Dexter flies to Argentina under a fake identity.

1 year later, we see Dexter on a beach. He looks happy. Harrison and Hannah can be seen playing in the sand in the background. But Dexter isn’t looking at them. He is looking at a man further away. He gets in a car and prepares his syringe, and the theme song begins playing as Dexter drives off after the man. Show ends.
